entities.summary: Caecilius of Calacte (b. 50 BCE, Kale Akte) was a political leader or statesperson of the Classical era, an age of empires, philosophical inquiry, and foundational civilizations, active in Kale Akte. Known in the fields of journalists & chroniclers.
